# VC-HB-3000

This part is obsolete.
Do not load a STEP for it.
The previous selection was the Kendrion model INTORQ.
The model code is BFK457-10 Compact.
The hold torque is 16 Nm.
At a ratio of 40 that is 640 Nm at the gearbox output.

- PLE120 T2Stop at i = 40 is 500 Nm.
- The brake can exceed that stop torque.
- The design uses the hold brake on the Siemens 1FL2104.
- See `docs/engineering/LIFT-DRIVE-SIZING.md`.

The repository no longer has the Compact STEP file.
So `load_vendor_shape` does not place it.
